title: Separate First, Fuse Later: Mitigating Cross-Modal Interference in Audio-Visual LLMs Reasoning with Modality-Specific Chain-of-Thought
abstract: arXiv:2605.09906v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Audio and vision provide complementary evidence for audio-visual question answering, yet current audio-visual large language models may suffer from cross-modal interference: information from one modality misguides the interpretation of another, thereby inducing hallucinations. We attribute this issue to uncontrolled cross-modal interactions during intermediate reasoning. To mitigate this, we propose Separate First, Fuse Later (SFFL), an audio-visual reasoning framework designed to reduce cross-modal interference. SFFL enforces modality-specific chain-of-thought reasoning, producing separate audio and visual reasoning traces and integrating evidence for answering. We construct modality-preference labels via a data pipeline under different modality input settings. translated_abstract: 音频与视觉为视听问答提供了互补的证据，然而当前的视听大语言模型可能受到跨模态干扰的影响：来自某一模态的信息会误导对另一模态的解读，从而引发幻觉。我们将这一问题归因于中间推理过程中不受控制的跨模态交互。为了缓解这一问题，我们提出了“先分离，后融合”（Separate First, Fuse Later, SFFL），一个旨在减少跨模态干扰的视听推理框架。SFFL强制执行模态特定的思维链推理，生成独立的音频和视觉推理轨迹，并整合证据以进行回答。我们通过一个数据管道，在不同的模态输入设置下构建模态偏好标签。我们将这些标签作为强化学习中的辅助奖励，以鼓励模型在回答时对模态线索形成依赖于具体实例的偏好。我们进一步引入了一个模……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出SFFL视听推理框架，通过模态特定的思维链推理先将音频与视觉推理过程分离再融合，并利用模态偏好标签作为强化学习的辅助奖励，从而缓解视听大语言模型中的跨模态干扰与幻觉问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes SFFL, an audio-visual reasoning framework that mitigates cross-modal interference in audio-visual LLMs by enforcing modality-specific chain-of-thought reasoning—separating audio and visual reasoning traces before fusing evidence—and leveraging modality-preference labels as auxiliary rewards in reinforcement learning.
